title: Regularity for degenerate or singular fully nonlinear elliptic equations with Hamiltonian terms and applications
summary: In this paper, we investigate regularity properties for viscosity solutions to a general class of degenerate or singular fully nonlinear elliptic equations with Hamiltonian terms, \[ \left\{ \begin{alignedat}{2} Φ(|Du|,x)F(D^{2}u,x)+H(|Du|,x) & =f(x) \quad && \text{in } \quad Ω,\\ u(x) & = g(x) \quad && \text{on } \quad \partialΩ. \end{alignedat} \right. \] Here, $F$ is uniformly elliptic, while $Φ$ and $H$ satisfy suitable structural and growth conditions allowing for both degenerate and singular regimes. Our first result establishes sharp global $C^{1,α}$ regularity for this general class…
